args.content:
Packing List for Hawaii Vacation

Based on the vacation itinerary for Hawaii (June 10-20, 2024), here is the essential packing list:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days, snorkeling, and kayaking)
- Sunscreen (essential for all outdoor activities)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike and other outdoor adventures)
- Casual outfits (for shopping, dining, and general activities)
- Camera (to capture memories of beautiful Hawaii)
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, hotel reservations, etc.)

Activity-Specific Items:
- Beach towel and beach bag
- Snorkeling equipment (if you prefer your own)
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Light rain jacket
- Formal attire for the Luau experience
- Waterproof phone case

Additional Recommendations:
- Sunglasses and hat
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Portable charger
- Reusable water bottle
